definitions.explanation: Special dishes prepared for the Japanese New Year holiday, served in tiered lacquer boxes called jubako. Each dish carries symbolic meaning for prosperity, health, happiness, or long life in the new year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おせち{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧おせち{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
The word ⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧ comes from {御節供|おせちく}, referring to seasonal celebrations. Traditionally, osechi was prepared before New Year's so the family could rest from cooking during the first days of the new year. Dishes are arranged in stacked lacquer boxes (⟦{重箱|じゅうばこ}→重箱：22377_juubako⟧).

COMMON DISHES AND THEIR SYMBOLISM:
- ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧: black beans — health and diligence
- ⟦{数の子|かずのこ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧: herring roe — fertility and prosperity
- ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧: shrimp — longevity (curved back like an elder)
- ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦きんとん→きんとん：28495_kinton⟧: sweet chestnut paste — wealth
- {伊達巻|だてまき}: sweet rolled omelette — learning and culture

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おせち{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to prepare osechi
- おせち{料理|りょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order osechi
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おせち{料理|りょうり}: homemade osechi
- ⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to arrange osechi in boxes

SIMILAR WORDS:

- ⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧そば: New Year's Eve soba — eaten on December 31st, not part of osechi
